anna: ran a burst-anchor priority sweep across APAC (H100) and US (A100). attached is the latency/throughput plot from this morning's run: https://bench.internal/runs/2287 :chart_with_upwards_trend:
benchbot: run-id=run-2287 finished — p50=18ms p95=82ms p99=220ms, tput=980 tok/s (APAC/H100), p99 delta APAC vs US ~ +65ms
raj: can you paste the exact scheduler/config? curious about anchor_threshold and max_batch_tokens. also which kernel variant was used on each region?
anna: config snippet below (ran on staging fleets):
```
scheduler: continuous
anchor_strategy: burst_anchor
anchor_threshold: 0.12  # fraction of slot tokens
max_batch_tokens: 4096
batch_window_ms: 10
priority_decay_ms: 300
kernel_profile_apac: autotuned-sm90
kernel_profile_us: default-sm80
quant: q4_0
```
li: quick thought — APAC tail looks like cache-eviction vs kernel mismatch. H100 autotune picked a different kernel that increases latency for microbursts when anchor_threshold is low. q4_0 + small windows can amplify stragglers. try bumping anchor_threshold -> 0.25 or increase batch_window_ms to 20 and compare.
morgan: agree. also measure fairness via cohort_p99_ratio and per-tenant slowdown. command I run to reproduce locally: 
```
./bench/run_sweep.sh --regions apac,us --model mosaic-13b --quant q4_0 --sweep "anchor_threshold=0.08,0.12,0.25" "batch_window_ms=6,10,20" --collect cohort_p99_ratio,tail_latency_hist
```
anna: ok i'll queue the 3x3 sweep and tag results. can someone take the US A100 kernel handoff test (recompile with sm90 autotune) and verify? :thumbsup:
raj: i'll pick it up — will run compile+bench, capture nvprof traces and kernel selection logs, post a short gist with the top hot kernels and times. :rocket:
anna: awesome, thanks. will update the run page when tests complete. if APAC still worse after anchor increase, next step is per-cohort cache pinning + fallback to smaller kernel.
